execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"
CREATE TYPE "public"."notification_type" AS ENUM ('LIKE', 'COMMENT', 'FOLLOW')
CREATE TYPE "public"."user_role" AS ENUM ('USER', 'ADMIN')

CREATE TABLE "public"."bookmarks" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "post_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "post_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."followers" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "follower_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "following_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("follower_id", "following_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."notifications" (
  "actor_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_read" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "post_id" int4,
  "recipient_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "type" "notification_type" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."post_comments" (
  "author_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "post_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."post_likes" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "post_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("user_id", "post_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."post_tags" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "post_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "tag_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("post_id", "tag_id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."posts" (
  "author_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."sessions" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expires_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "jwt_token" text NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tags" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."user_profiles" (
  "bio" text,
  "full_name" character varying(255),
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "location" character varying(255),
  "profile_picture_url" character varying(255),
  "updated_at" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" int4 NOT NULL,
  "username" character varying(255),
  "website" character varying(255),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" character varying(255) NOT NULL,
  "role" "user_role" DEFAULT 'USER'::"user_role" NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
CREATE INDEX "idx_bookmarks_user_id" ON "public"."bookmarks" ("user_id")
CREATE INDEX "idx_followers_following_id" ON "public"."followers" ("following_id")
CREATE INDEX "idx_notifications_recipient_unread" ON "public"."notifications" ("recipient_id", "is_read")
CREATE INDEX "idx_post_comments_post_id" ON "public"."post_comments" ("post_id")
CREATE INDEX "idx_post_likes_post_id" ON "public"."post_likes" ("post_id")
CREATE INDEX "idx_post_tags_tag_id" ON "public"."post_tags" ("tag_id")
CREATE INDEX "idx_posts_author_id" ON "public"."posts" ("author_id")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "tags_name_key" ON "public"."tags" ("name")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "user_profiles_user_id_key" ON "public"."user_profiles" ("user_id")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "user_profiles_username_key" ON "public"."user_profiles" ("username")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "users_email_key" ON "public"."users" ("email")
